request.prompt: Original instrumental ambient exploration music for a quiet dusty desert science fiction colony city at golden hour. An early 2000s computer role playing game atmosphere: warm analogue synth pads, sparse plucked oud-like strings, distant breathy flute textures, occasional very soft frame drum accents, spacious weathered sound. Unhurried, contemplative, a little mysterious but welcoming. Low intensity, no strong beat or big swells, no cinematic climax. A restrained repeating modal motif over a steady tonal drone, harmonious beginning and ending suitable for a looping background bed. Exactly 40 seconds. Instrumental only, no singing, no speech, no choir.
